verse.verse_1: AN INQUIRER ASKED for the affliction that is to come
verse.verse_2: Upon the infidels -- which none would be able to repel --
verse.verse_3: From God, the Lord of the steps (of progression),
verse.verse_4: To whom the angels and the soul take a day to ascend, whose length is fifty thousand years.
verse.verse_6: They surely take it to be far away,
verse.verse_7: But We see it very near.
verse.verse_8: The day the sky becomes like molten brass,
verse.verse_9: The mountains like the tufts of (carded) wool,
verse.verse_10: And no friend inquires after friend
verse.verse_11: Though within sight of one another. The sinner would like to ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his sons,
verse.verse_13: And his family who had stood by him,
verse.verse_14: And all those who are on the earth, to save himself.
verse.verse_15: But never. It is pure white flame
verse.verse_17: It will summon whoever turns his back and flees,
verse.verse_19: Surely man is greedy by nature.
verse.verse_20: If evil befalls him he is perturbed;
verse.verse_21: If good comes to him he holds back his hand,
verse.verse_22: Except those who closely follow (the Book of God),
verse.verse_24: In whose wealth a due share is included
verse.verse_25: For the needy and those dispossessed,
verse.verse_26: And those who believe in the Day of Judgement,
verse.verse_27: And those who fear the punishment of their Lord, --
verse.verse_28: Surely no one can be secure from the punishment of his Lord, --
verse.verse_29: And those who guard their sex except from their wives and women slaves of old
verse.verse_31: But those who seek more than this will be transgressors;
verse.verse_32: And those who fulfil their trusts and covenants,
verse.verse_34: And those who are mindful of their moral obligations.
verse.verse_35: They will live in gardens with honour.
verse.verse_36: What is the matter with unbelievers that they stare at you with fixed gazes and hasten towards you
verse.verse_38: Does every one of them wish to enter the garden of tranquility?
verse.verse_39: Never so. We have created them from what they know.
verse.verse_40: So I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests that We are certainly able
verse.verse_41: To bring better people than they in their place; and they will not be able to thwart Us.
verse.verse_42: So leave them to their vain disputes and amusement till they meet their day (of reckoning) promised them,
verse.verse_43: The day when they will come out of their graves in all haste as though rushing to their altars,
verse.verse_44: Eyes lowered, shame attending. That is the day they have been promised!
